operationLog.dialog.title: 操作記錄
operationLog.dialog.loadError: 無法載入你的操作記錄。請稍後再試一次。
operationLog.dialog.empty: 還沒有任何操作。複製、移動、重新命名或刪除一些東西，就會顯示在這裡。
operationLog.dialog.recordingOff: 「操作記錄」目前沒有在記錄，所以新的複製、移動、重新命名和刪除不會出現在這裡，也無法還原。到「設定」重新開啟，就能再次記錄。
operationLog.dialog.noItems: 這項操作沒有記錄任何項目。
operationLog.dialog.rollBackSelected: {count, plural, one {Roll back selected ({countText})} other {Roll back selected ({countText})}}
operationLog.dialog.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {{selectedText} of {selectableText} selected} other {{selectedText} of {selectableText} selected}}
operationLog.tree.label: Items
operationLog.tree.rollupRolledBack: {count, plural, one {{countText} rolled back} other {{countText} rolled back}}
operationLog.tree.operationSkipped: The operation skipped this one, so there’s nothing to roll back.
operationLog.tree.operationUnfinished: The operation didn’t finish this one, so there’s nothing to roll back.
operationLog.tree.unexpandableNotRecorde: Cmdr didn’t record what’s inside this folder.
operationLog.tree.unexpandableCapped: Cmdr didn’t record what’s inside this folder, because this operation held a folder of over 50,000 files.
operationLog.tree.indexesBuilding: Cmdr is getting your history ready after an update. The items show up in a moment.
operationLog.tree.operationRunning: This operation is still running. Its items show up here once it’s done.
operationLog.tree.rollingBack: This operation is rolling back. Its items show up here once that’s done.
operationLog.tree.unreadable: Couldn’t read this operation’s items. Pick it again to try once more.
operationLog.tree.togglesCapped: That’s as many separate picks as Cmdr can hold. Pick a folder instead.
operationLog.skipReason.unverifiablePrec: Cmdr couldn’t check this against what it recorded, so it left it alone.
operationLog.skipReason.drift: This changed since the operation, so Cmdr left it alone.
operationLog.skipReason.restoreTargetOcc: Something else is at the original spot now, so Cmdr didn’t overwrite it.
operationLog.skipReason.dirNotEmpty: This folder has something new in it, so Cmdr kept it.
operationLog.skipReason.alreadyGone: This was already back the way it was.
operationLog.skipReason.vanished: This is gone from where the operation left it, so there’s nothing to put back.
operationLog.skipReason.originalGone: The original is gone, so Cmdr kept this copy rather than delete the only one left.
operationLog.skipReason.failed: Cmdr couldn’t roll this one back. Its log has the details.
operationLog.skipReason.locked: This is locked so that only an administrator can remove it, so Cmdr left it.
operationLog.summary.copy: {count, plural, other {已複製 {countText} 個項目}}
operationLog.summary.move: {count, plural, other {已移動 {countText} 個項目}}
operationLog.summary.delete: {count, plural, other {已刪除 {countText} 個項目}}
operationLog.summary.trash: {count, plural, other {已將 {countText} 個項目移到垃圾桶}}
operationLog.summary.rename: {count, plural, other {已重新命名 {countText} 個項目}}
operationLog.summary.createFolder: {count, plural, other {已新增 {countText} 個資料夾}}
operationLog.summary.createFile: {count, plural, other {已新增 {countText} 個檔案}}
operationLog.summary.compress: {count, plural, other {已壓縮 {countText} 個項目}}
operationLog.summary.tag: {count, plural, other {已更改 {countText} 個項目的標籤}}
operationLog.rollback.partiallyRolledBac: Cmdr 能復原的都復原了，其餘的維持原樣。完成復原會再走一遍，仍然會略過沒有把握的部分。
operationLog.rollback.partialRolledBack: {count, plural, one {{countText} item is back the way it was.} other {{countText} items are back the way they were.}}
operationLog.rollback.partialHeldBack: {count, plural, one {Cmdr skipped {countText} item it wasn’t sure about.} other {Cmdr skipped {countText} items it wasn’t sure about.}}
operationLog.rollback.partialWaiting: {count, plural, one {{countText} item hasn’t been rolled back yet.} other {{countText} items haven’t been rolled back yet.}}
operationLog.rollback.rollbackableNotice: Rolling back deletes the selected copies. The originals stay where they are.
Rolling back deletes the selected items this operation created.
Rolling back moves the selected items back where they came from.
Rolling back gives the selected items their old names back.
Rolling back gives the selected items the tags they had before.
operationLog.rollback.refusalAlreadyRoll: 這一項已經在復原了。可以在「操作佇列」裡看它的進度。
這一項已經回到原本的樣子了。
operationLog.rollback.refusalOverwrote: 這項操作取代了原本就在那裡的檔案。Cmdr 不會保留被取代檔案的副本，所以原本的檔案回不來了。
operationLog.rollback.refusalPermanentDe: 永久刪除不會留下任何可以放回去的東西。
operationLog.rollback.refusalArchiveOver: 這個封存檔取代了原本同名的舊檔案。Cmdr 不會保留被取代檔案的副本，所以舊的那個回不來了。
operationLog.rollback.refusalZipEditUnsu: Cmdr 還不能復原在封存檔裡面做的更動。
operationLog.rollback.refusalJournalInco: Cmdr 對這項操作的記錄並不完整，復原有可能動到不該動的檔案。
operationLog.rollback.refusalDirectoryMe: 這次移動把資料夾合併到原本就在那裡的同名資料夾裡了。Cmdr 分不出哪些檔案是跟著移過來的、哪些原本就在裡面，所以沒有安全的復原方式。
operationLog.rollback.refusalStagedConfl: 這次移動遇到已經被佔走的名稱，問過你要怎麼處理。那個回答已經是結果的一部分了，所以沒有單一的復原方式。
operationLog.rollback.refusalVolumeUnava: 請連接這項操作用過的磁碟機，然後再試一次。
operationLog.rollback.refusalUnknown: 這項操作已經不在你的歷史記錄裡了。
operationLog.rollback.refusalNothingSele: Check at least one item to roll back.
operationLog.rollback.refusalSummaryNotB: Cmdr is still reading this operation’s items. Try again in a moment.
operationLog.rollback.refusalTooManyTogg: That’s more separate picks than Cmdr can hold. Pick a folder instead.
operationLog.rollback.refusalUnexpected: Cmdr 無法開始復原。請稍後再試一次。
